title: Swing: preflight then EDT commit
summary: The project applies a two-phase render rule: validate revision/operation/instance/definition state first, then commit on the EDT. Do not half-mutate widgets and discover the patch is invalid halfway through.
invariants: A failed structural patch retains the previously committed tree.
Structural relayout should preserve existing JComponent instances unless the semantic protocol explicitly replaces them.
Stamp view/revision when the Swing event is queued; later renderer advancement must not rewrite historical user-action context.
